structure: Part 13 mined two end-to-end traces from journeys.fit.spec.js › notification journeys end to end, both passed with no recorded errors, every action read: (1) 'pet-cats-by-air' = journeys--notification-journeys-end-to-end-pet-cats-by-air-microchip-identification-and-permanent-address.zip (262 actions, 1343 requests, reference GBN-AG-26-0B0YRZ) and (2) 'poultry-by-rail' = journeys--notification-journeys-end-to-end-poultry-by-rail-no-identification-transit-countries.zip (257 actions, 1263 requests, reference GBN-AG-26-03NFQ6). Refs below read 'trace <short name> action <id>' (a snapshot taken before that action) or 'request <id>'. journeys.fit.spec.js was read for test titles and the journey inputs only. Page order, pet cats: create-notification (302) > notification-type 'What are you importing?' (Live animals) > origin-of-the-import (Spain, no region code) > what-are-you-importing (Domestic cat, Felis catus) > reason-for-import (Internal market / Companion animal not for resale or rehoming) > consignment-details (2 animals) > animal-identification-details three times (Microchip, Passport, Tattoo for cat 1 of 2, then 2 of 2, then the saved table) > additional-animal-details (Other) > arrival-details (Air, London Heathrow) > transporter (Aberdeen Livestock Ltd) > upload-documents twice (one ITAHC added, then continue) > roles-and-addresses with place-of-origin, consignor-or-exporter, consignee, importer, place-of-destination each picked from a table and returning to roles-and-addresses, then permanent-address (302 to permanent-address/select; cat 1 same as POD, cat 2 a new York address) > contact-address-for-consignment > review-notification > notification-hub (navigated to) > review-notification > declaration (blank submit shows the error, then confirmed) > notification-submitted > review-notification?reference=... (the submitted view). Page order, poultry: the same, except origin is Germany, reason-for-import is Transit (port of exit Holyhead POE - GBHLY, destination Republic of Ireland), consignment-details (400 chickens) goes straight to additional-animal-details (Slaughter) with no identification page, arrival-details (Rail, Dover - GBDVR) is followed by transit-countries (Belgium, France), transporter is Danish Meat Export ApS, and roles-and-addresses offers a county parish holding (CPH) number page (12/345/6789) instead of a permanent address. Conditional pages in this slice: identification details (cats, not chickens), permanent address (cats), CPH number (chickens), transit countries (after Rail, not after Air), number of packages field (cats, not chickens). The hub, review, declaration, submitted confirmation and submitted view were each mined in both traces. The network logs show only same-origin page GETs and form POSTs answered with 302 redirects (plus prototype-kit live-reload polling on localhost:3011, ignored); no external system is called. Not reached in either trace: validation errors on any journey page other than the declaration, the region of origin Yes branch, add-a-transporter, add-a-new-address, View details, Remove, Change, the amend modal's Yes path, Copy as new and Delete; these are recorded as gaps. This part file was rewritten on a resumed run: both traces were reopened and their full action lists re-read (cat-actions2.txt, poultry-actions2.txt), the permanent address, review and CPH pages were re-checked against fresh and earlier snapshots, and the earlier extract's claims for this slice were kept under their ids where the traces still say the same thing.
